An '''ignition switch''' was a component used to start [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. If removed from a vehicle, the ignition switch could be used as a lock picker by attaching the positive cable to the lock's [[boreen]] and the negative cable to the [[wetter plate]].
